Toolkit EoCServer.dll+0xB1F0A0 esv::concentration::ConcentrationSystem::GatherAddTargetOnSummon, second loop: the byte at +8 is passed as the `bool` parameter of eoc::concentration::ConcentrationComponent::Target::Target(handle, bool, handle) - so a bool (Script Extender declares uint8_t field_8, Summon.h:28). Which member of Target it sets was not read; the name waits.
